observations.pertica: Specimen shows a central axis and bifurcating attached laterals. Separate government artist reconstruction is dense with naked complex lateral forks and terminal sporangial clusters, not foliage. Specimen is not a full preserved plant. Source text gives four ranks spiraling up stem, fertile and sterile systems. Wiley primary article inaccessible403; use actual official specimen and first-party curated description, retaining species-level architectural uncertainty.
observations.hormosiroidea: PRI76855 thumbnail shows a gently curved chain of rounded chambers in a thin irregular slab. Some preservation is weak; narrowed connectors conceptually enhanced. Devonian refers to this named Ludlowville specimen only. Cambridge primary text inspected confirms unbranched sinuous serial subspherical nodes and ongoing Halimedides dispute; do not change nomenclature or assert maker.
observations.zoophycos: Zhang2015 Fig1 personally inspected: a-d computer reconstructions distinct from e-h specimens. Simple circular helical sheet, central cylindrical connection, marginal tube, curved radial primary lamellae. Use 1.25-turn illustrative simple relief, not specific reconstructed organism; PRI locality unknown and inventory eras remain empty.
observations.lumbricaria: PRI76858 thumbnail shows compact irregular tangled long thin cords with open loops on pale slab. Relief shallow; crossings compressed and ambiguous. Jurassic is specific Solnhofen specimen only. No definite producer.
